230204: Haruka Sakura is a high school student in his first year. He attends Fuurin, a school known as a delinquent school, with aspirations to reach the top. He admires strong people. Rejected by others for his rough appearance, being alone was natural for him.
255627: A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Nirei is weak at fighting, but his frank personality livens up the room — he's the life of the class. He wants to protect the town more than anybody else and thus has always aspired to become a student at Furin High School.
255628: A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Sugishita's a mad dog and quite talented — he's the only one who's been allowed to call himself "Bofurin" since middle school.
255629: A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Suo has a refreshing smile and is pleasant to everyone he meets, but his outrageous jokes can cause chaos to the people around him.
255630: A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Umemiya is Bofurin's representative, meaning he stands at the top.
318248: A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. One of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Hiragi is the leader of the Tamon Team. Hiragi is highly strung and possesses a strong sense of responsibility, often finding himself being pushed around by the overly gracious Umemiya.
329046: A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Always lifting weights and never without his protein shake, Tsugeura possesses a bright and honest personality that makes all his friends admire him.
329047: A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Toshiyuki’s gentle-mannered personality and thoughtfulness make him popular with the ladies, but he’s no pushover — his fighting abilities are the real deal.
329049: Kotoha works at Café Pothos. Her friendly and brave personality makes her seem like an adult, but just like Sakura and the others, she’s only 16. As manager of Café Pothos, she serves the best menu to the students at Furin High School and the local townspeople everyday.
332988: A member of Shishitoren. He doesn't say much, so it's hard to figure out what he's thinking. Kota's not the type of person to suggest a one-on-one fight, but it seems he has some unknown beef in the past with Hiragi, so he picks a fight with Hiragi himself.
332991: The second-in-command of Shishitoren. Donning monk's working clothes and a pair of Japanese geta, Togame's eyes hide behind a pair of sunglasses as he talks at a slow tempo and pace. He possesses a cruel and unforgiving personality.
332992: The leader of Shishitoren. He believes that the stronger someone is, the more free they are. Tomiyama wants to create a fun environment for Shishitoren, where members can feel the most free they've ever felt.
332993: A member of Shishitoren. He's always doing things with Kanuma. Valuing power over anything else, there had been a case where he broke several ribs of his opponent in one hit.
333619: A member of Shishitoren. Kanuma and Arima are like brothers — they're always doing something together. He has a habit of putting his hands over his mouth and uses a childish manner of speaking.
342034: A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1.
347857: Endo is a laid-back young man that is always shown to have a carefree and warm nature when fighting.
